steps.title: Clean Project Environment Initialization
steps.description: Initialize build-level script parameters, namespace definitions, and targeted SDK parameters for Smart Notes.

steps.title: Configure Manifest Declarations
steps.description: Define layout orientations, primary hardware permissions, and entry point actions inside the AndroidManifest file.

steps.title: Establish SQLite Notes Database
steps.description: Implement local storage structure for Notes and Categories, writing search and update routines inside the DatabaseHelper class.

steps.title: Design Unified Single-Activity UI Layout
steps.description: Formulate a structural UI layout split into List Mode, Note Editor Mode, and Category Management popups within standard Material themes.

steps.title: Program Main Application Controller Hookup
steps.description: Initialize layout view references, click triggers, and core state management properties inside MainActivity.

steps.title: Seed Default Categories System
steps.description: Populate localized category rows with 'Personal', 'Work', 'Ideas', and 'Uncategorized' tags during application database creation.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Category Loading
steps.description: Write adaptive Spinner populate helpers that render user-created lists of categories into dropdown select layouts.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Custom Notes Render engine
steps.description: Write standard-view creation loops that dynamically inflate note rows with Title, Category Tag, text excerpts, edit options, and delete options.

steps.title: Integrate Real-Time Search Filtering
steps.description: Bind a custom TextWatcher listener onto the search bar to support instant text queries cross-filtering with Category selectors.

steps.title: Integrate Create and Edit Forms Manager
steps.description: Formulate input field validation, category assignments, and database UPDATE vs INSERT routing switches when saving notes.

steps.title: Configure Note Deletion Workflows
steps.description: Write secure database delete hooks connected to direct delete dialog triggers complete with quick list updates and visual notifications.

steps.title: Building Smart Notes
steps.description: Execute Gradle compilation processes, compile custom Java files, verify local packages assets, and prepare debugging builds.
